name: Welcome to BP brother

card.summary: A 2026 TikTok catchphrase and edit meme that welcomes someone to the blackpill, the belief that looks drive dating and success, spreading looksmaxxing vocabulary and motivation among viewers.
card.note: Mostly ironic meme; the blackpill worldview behind it is a fatalistic looks-centered outlook.

quick.overview:
"Welcome to BP brother" is a looksmaxxing catchphrase from TikTok in 2026. "BP" stands for blackpill, the belief that looks and attractiveness are what matter most for dating and success. The phrase is often paired with a GIF of Cristiano Ronaldo smiling in an unsettling way.

Its link to appearance is cultural: the meme spreads the vocabulary of looksmaxxing and nudges viewers toward thinking about their looks. It is closely related to the broader BP TikTok edit trend.
quick.how: People use it as a comment or edit caption, mostly ironically. Many videos are comedy skits in which a rejected man is welcomed to BP after something goes wrong, often in dating.
quick.risks: The meme carries a fatalistic looks-first worldview. Some creators say BP-style edits left them demotivated, and parent-facing outlets describe BP edits aimed at shaming people.

lead: "Welcome to BP brother", also called "BP Ronaldo", is a 2026 looksmaxxing catchphrase from TikTok. According to Know Your Meme, a user's comment reading "Welcome to bp brother" was edited around June 22-23, 2026 together with a GIF of Cristiano Ronaldo smiling, and the post passed 453,000 views within a week [1].

"BP" stands for blackpill. The commenter's profile said the phrase essentially means a "crashout" [1]. The phrase spread through the looksmaxxing community in late June 2026, mostly ironically, in comedy skits where a rejected man is welcomed to BP after a setback [1].

It sits within the wider BP TikTok edits trend of 2025, where videos urge viewers to prioritise looks and contrast people seen as unattractive with looksmaxxing figures. Critics note the ideals skew white, and some creators said the edits demotivated them [2].

chain: Viewers pay more attention to appearance
angle.text: The meme is not a technique. It spreads blackpill and looksmaxxing language that can lead viewers toward looksmaxxing content.

paras: Know Your Meme dates the original comment and edit to around June 22-23, 2026. Skits followed on June 25 and 29, drawing hundreds of thousands of views [1].
BP TikTok edits gained traction in 2025, with hashtags such as #BPEdit and early examples drawing hundreds of thousands of plays; parody videos also circulated [2].

timeline.event: "Welcome to BP brother" spreads in late June [1].
